sources.title: STT En Fast Conformer-CTC Large | NVIDIA NGC
sources.snippet: Model Overview This collection contains large size versions of Fast Conformer-CTC (around 115M parameters) trained on NeMo ASRSet with around 24500 hours of english speech. The model transcribes speech in lower case english alphabet along with spaces and apostrophes.
